name: CASSINO
description: Cassino (also spelled Casino) is a classic fishing-capture card game originating in Italy and popular throughout the world. Players capture cards from a central tableau by matching rank (pairing) or arithmetic sum (combining). Special prizes exist for the Ten of Diamonds ('Big Cassino', worth 2 points) and Two of Spades ('Little Cassino', worth 1 point). The first player or team to reach 11 (or 21 in some variants) points wins.

content.text: Cassino (also spelled Casino) is a classic fishing-capture card game originating in Italy and popular throughout the world. Players capture cards from a central tableau by matching rank (pairing) or arithmetic sum (combining). Special prizes exist for the Ten of Diamonds ('Big Cassino', worth 2 points) and Two of Spades ('Little Cassino', worth 1 point). The first player or team to reach 11 (or 21 in some variants) points wins.
Cassino is one of the oldest fishing-type games in European card culture, with Italian origins. It was described in English-language card game books as early as the late 18th century.
4 cards each; 4 cards face-up on table (the 'tableau'). Rest is stock. Redeal 4 each when hands empty until stock gone.

items.text: Royal Cassino: Aces count as 1 OR 14. Jacks = 11, Queens = 12, Kings = 13 for building purposes. Creates much richer building combinations.
Draw Cassino: Players draw to replenish hand to 4 after each turn, rather than waiting for the whole hand to run out.
